en: You've met Sonia, then! She'll make a professor of herself one day, if she ever stops reading long enough.
text: Deci ai cunoscut-o pe Sonia! O să ajungă profesoară într-o zi, dacă se oprește vreodată din citit destul de mult.

en: Champion! I've been reading about the Wishing Stars again, and about a stone from Kalos whose light does something very like theirs.
Is that a Key Stone? And your Dynamax Band! Hold still, I want to try something I've only ever drawn on paper.
Sonia sets a sliver of Wishing Star beside a Key Stone of her own into a new band, and the two lights run together.
There! A Mega Max Band. With this, a Pokémon that's Mega Evolved can still Dynamax. Keep your old band and stone, too.
Oh, and the Watt traders say a den by the Lake of Outrage has started glowing black. Something Mega-sized, I'd bet.
If you ever find a Key Stone, from Kalos I'd guess, bring it here with your Dynamax Band. I've a band I'm itching to build.
How's the Mega Max Band? I want every reading you can bring me from that den by the Lake of Outrage!
